_comment: Checkov reports no severity without a paid Prisma Cloud key, so every Checkov finding would be 'medium' and none would block. These checks are the scanning baseline's policy (docs/reports/2026-11-24-cloud-provider-comparison.md, section 7: deny public buckets, wildcard IAM and unencrypted storage, plus hard-coded credentials); scan.py rates them high, which blocks a PR at the default --fail-on. Trivy config rates its own equivalents (AVD-AWS-*) itself. Add a check id here with the reason in the commit message.

_checkov_high_index.public buckets: CKV_AWS_20 public READ ACL, CKV_AWS_57 public WRITE ACL, CKV_AWS_53-56 the four S3 public access block settings, CKV_AWS_70 bucket policy action for any principal
_checkov_high_index.unencrypted storage: CKV_AWS_19 S3 at rest, CKV_AWS_3 EBS, CKV_AWS_8 instance or launch configuration EBS, CKV_AWS_16 RDS at rest, CKV_AWS_17 RDS publicly accessible, CKV_AWS_27 SQS, CKV_AWS_64 Redshift, CKV_AWS_7 CMK rotation, CKV_AWS_33 KMS key policy wildcard principal
_checkov_high_index.wildcard IAM: CKV_AWS_1/62 full '*-*' admin, CKV_AWS_49/63 '*' actions, CKV_AWS_107-111 and CKV_AWS_286-290 credentials exposure, data exfiltration, permissions management, privilege escalation, unconstrained write; CKV_AWS_355 '*' resource for restrictable actions; CKV_AWS_60/61 role assumable by any principal or service
_checkov_high_index.credentials: CKV_AWS_41 hard-coded keys in the provider, CKV_AWS_45 secrets in Lambda environment, CKV_AWS_46 secrets in EC2 user data
_checkov_high_index.network exposure: CKV_AWS_24 SSH and CKV_AWS_25 RDP from 0.0.0.0/0, CKV_AWS_277 all ports from 0.0.0.0/0
_checkov_high_index.logging: CKV_AWS_67 CloudTrail in all regions, CKV_AWS_36 CloudTrail log file validation, CKV_AWS_35 CloudTrail logs encrypted with a CMK
_checkov_high_index.containers: CKV_DOCKER_8 last USER is root, CKV_K8S_16 privileged container, CKV_K8S_20 allowPrivilegeEscalation
_checkov_high_index._source: names from `checkov --list` (Checkov 3.4.10); kept medium on purpose: CKV_AWS_145 S3 KMS-by-default (SSE-S3 is the baseline), CKV_AWS_149 and CKV_AWS_158 CMK for secrets and log groups, CKV_AWS_260 port 80 from anywhere (a public load balancer)
